title: 第17章 蚁的故事
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
罗影盘膝坐在床沿上，摊开了自己的右手。

    手背上【赴死蚁】的图案静静伏着，就连装出来的瘸腿也纤毫毕现。

    他闭上眼睛，内心一点一点沉入到手掌的背面。

    【赴死蚁】缩在手掌背面的一个很小的阴影中。

    即使已经缔结了条约，也进入了这只属于他俩的世界...

    它依然保持着一种本能，把自己缩成最小的一个球。

    罗影的心境才刚探过去。

    手背上那道图案，便遽然一缩。

    一种无法抑制的恐惧，顺着契约猛然反冲。

    它怕。

    罗影能从那些纠结的心绪中，清晰地感受到那股战栗。

    明明签订了契约，藏在自己的身体里，这应该是世界上最为安全的地方了。

    再没有食蚁兽，再没有穿山甲。

    可它还是怕。

    它怕的，是他。

    是他这个，庞大到能随手将它碾死千百回的契主。

    罗影没有再往前探。

    他把那道心绪，停在原地，声音放得极轻极轻：

    “别怕。我给你取个名儿，叫小玄，成么？”

    那道契约的另一头，却没有半分回应。

    只有那图案上显现的身影，缩得更紧了些。

    ......

    七天的工夫，就这么，缓缓地过去了。

    这七日，罗影白天在家。

    大哥罗川天不亮就去了镇上码头扛货，爹的腰还没大好，家里冷锅冷灶。

    夜里，他便一遍一遍，循着那道契约，去试着靠近它。

    他从不强求。

    有时，他顺着那道心绪，递过去一丝暖意。

    有时，只是在心里头，轻轻唤它一声小玄。

    可七日里，它一回都没应过他。

    它躲着他。

    像躲着这世上所有比它强大的东西一样，躲着他这个，本该护它周全的人。

    罗影心里头，说不出是个什么滋味。

    他亲手把它从那片废堆里捧了出来，给了它一个名字，一处安身的地方。

    可它，连从那道契约里，朝他递来一丝气息，都不肯。

    而明天...

    明天，便是【御兽进化论】开课的日子了。

    罗影却没和它，真心实意的交谈过一次。

    .......

    夜深了。

    罗影没有再像前几日那样，徒劳地去触碰它。

    他低头，借着窗外那点稀薄的月光，看着手背上那道图案。

    把这只蚁，从头到尾，又想了一遍。

    前世三十年，他钻研了大半辈子飞禽走兽。

    他见过怕生的兽，见过胆小的兽。

    可怕到这个份上，怕到连给它遮风挡雨的人都信不过的……

    那不是寻常的胆小。

    那是心里头，藏着一桩压得它喘不过气的事。

    是它受过什么，旁人想都想不到的伤。

    这几分，罗影隐隐地，已经能猜到了。

    它那两根黯淡得快熄了的无畏之心光柱，它那一身装出来的残...

    以及它那极度的怕死...

    这些凑在一处，分明，是一个说不出口的故事。

    他想了想。

    要走进一个把事藏了一辈子的人心里，光递暖意，是没用的。

    得先，听一听它的故事。

    罗影闭上眼，循着那道契约，没有去碰它，只是在心里头，轻轻问了一句。

    “小玄。”

    “跟我，说说你的事，好么？”

    那道契约的另一头，怔住了。
content_en:
Luo Ying sat cross-legged on the edge of the bed and spread his right hand.

The pattern of "Ant to Death" on the back of the hand lies quietly, and even the pretended lameness is fully visible.

He closed his eyes and his heart sank into the back of his hands little by little.

[Death Ant] huddled in a small shadow on the back of the palm.

Even though they have concluded a treaty, they have entered a world that belongs only to them...

It still maintains an instinct to shrink itself into the smallest ball.

Luo Ying's state of mind has just been explored.

The pattern on the back of his hand suddenly shrank.

An uncontrollable fear surged back along the contract.

It's afraid.

Luo Ying could clearly feel the trembling from those tangled emotions.

He obviously signed a contract and hid it in his body. This should be the safest place in the world.

No more anteaters, no more pangolins.

But it is still afraid.

It was him that it was afraid of.

It's him, the contract owner who is so big that he can easily crush it to death thousands of times.

Luo Ying did not explore further.

He stopped that thought in place and spoke very softly:

"Don't be afraid. I'll name you Xiaoxuan, okay?"

There was no response from the other end of the contract.

Only the figure shown on the pattern shrank tighter.

...

Seven days passed slowly like this.

During these seven days, Luo Ying was at home during the day.

The eldest brother Luo Chuan went to the town dock before dawn to carry goods. His father's waist was not yet healed, so the family was cold.

At night, he followed the contract over and over again, trying to get closer to it.

He never forced anything.

Sometimes, he followed that mood and handed over a hint of warmth.

Sometimes, I just call it Xiaoxuan gently in my heart.

But for seven days, it didn't respond to him once.

It hid from him.

Just like hiding from everything stronger than it in the world, it is hiding from him, the person who should protect it.

Luo Ying couldn't tell what he felt in his heart.

He took it out of the rubble with his own hands and gave it a name and a place to rest.

But it refused to even send him a breath from the contract.

And tomorrow...

Tomorrow is the day when the [Evolutionary Theory of Beast Control] class starts.

Luo Ying did not have a sincere conversation with it.

.......

It's late at night.

Luo Ying did not touch it in vain like he did a few days ago.

He lowered his head and looked at the pattern on the back of his hand through the thin moonlight outside the window.

Think about this ant again from beginning to end.

For thirty years in his previous life, he had studied birds and beasts for most of his life.

He has seen beasts that are afraid of strangers, and he has seen beasts that are timid.

It's so scary that it can't even trust the people who protect it from the wind and rain...

That's not ordinary timidity.

There is something in my heart that is weighing me down.

It was an injury that no one else could imagine.

Luo Ying could vaguely guess this.

Its two pillars of fearless heart were so dim that they were almost extinguished, and the frailty it pretended to be...

And its extreme fear of death...

Putting these together, it is clear that it is an unspeakable story.

He thought about it.

To get into the heart of a person who has hidden things all his life, it is useless to just send him warmth.

First, listen to its story.

Luo Ying closed his eyes and followed the contract without touching it. He just asked softly in his heart.

"Xiao Xuan."

"Tell me about you, okay?"

The person on the other side of the contract was stunned.
